messages:
alex: heads up 1: build-health shows client checksum mismatches during canary of runtime-3.2 in us-west pool. rate ~0.7% on short runs (5m).

rina: any correlation with SDK 2.9.1 or quant profile?

alex: logs point to SDK 2.9.1 + zero-copy path. stack: `Client: checksum mismatch on chunk 3/8`. appears during streaming handoff.

joseph: we rolled SDK 2.9.1 yesterday for consumers. runtime-3.2 is new too. Could be client <-> runtime contract regression.

pat: quick question1: are errors causing user-facing failures or retries? severity matters for pin decision.

alex: mostly retries but a few corrupted outputs reported in telemetry. not widespread yet but trending.

release-manager: propose immediate targeted pin: keep runtime-3.2 global but pin us-west pool back to runtime-3.1 for safety while we investigate. open to pinning SDK instead?

joseph: pinning SDK on many clients is hard. pinning runtime per pool is easier operationally. +1 for us-west pin.

deploybot: Deploybot: recommended action: `pin-runtime us-west 3.1 --reason "checksum errors with SDK-2.9.1 canary"` . Scheduled change window: 23:00-01:00 UTC tonight.

eng-sre-bot: eng-sre-bot: rollback criteria suggestion: sustained checksum error rate >0.5% for 10m OR token corruption >0.1% for 5m OR increase in p95 latency >200ms over baseline.

rina: agree with criteria. also add automated alert to #incidents if criteria met.

qa: QA: can run targeted streaming smoke lanes against us-west once pinned and also run reproducer for `stream-chat --chunked`. need ~18m.

release-manager: Action: apply an immediate hold on the global unpin for runtime-3.2 and schedule a runtime pin for us-west at next safe window (in 25m). assign owners: @joseph to submit pin request, @qa to validate, @alex to triage logs.

joseph: submitting pin now. `/pin-runtime us-west 3.1 --owner joseph --ticket RN-5120`

deploybot: Deploybot: Pin request received: runtime=3.1, pool=us-west, ticket=RN-5120. Preflight checks: capacity ok, no outstanding locks. Applying pin in 25m unless canceled.

alex: starting deeper traces: enabling extra client-side checks and capturing post-handshake payloads. will share S3 link.

ci-bot: ci-bot: TODO: add lint rule to warn on SDK/runtime symbol mismatch (tracking: infra#990).

pat: if QA reproduces locally, we should escalate to rollback plan for global canary. But start with this localized pin.

qa: smoke lanes started against pinned pool (when applied). first 10m: checksum mismatches dropped to ~0.02% (baseline 0.01%). no corrupted outputs seen.

joseph: good early signal. I'll hold the global unpin and draft release note blurb: "Temporarily pinned us-west to runtime-3.1 following client checksum mismatches during SDK 2.9.1 canary; investigation ongoing."

release-manager: timeline: 1) pin applied tonight in window, QA validation 30m post-pin. 2) Continue triage: if root cause indicates SDK shim issue, we'll coordinate SDK patch and CI lint. 3) Clear pin and proceed with unpin tomorrow 03:00 UTC if green.

deploybot: Deploybot: Pin applied: runtime=3.1 on pool=us-west by joseph. Auto-clear scheduled: 2026-03-22T03:00:00Z unless incident opened.

alex: uploaded traces to s3://redwood-debug/173/1765439999.tar.gz. initial diff shows handshake parity fails when `stream_chunk_order` flag set.

rina: good catch 1: that flag was introduced in SDK 2.9.1. could be sequence handling bug. I'll reproduce with SDK v2.9.0 vs 2.9.1 to confirm.

joseph: noting next steps: 1) eng-sre to update incident alerts, 2) infra to add ci lint (ci-bot), 3) SDK owners to run compatibility static checks. I'll create a short postmortem draft after root cause.

qa: final check after 35m: pinned pool stable. token corruption 0, checksum ~0.01%. passing.

release-manager: OK to keep pin overnight. @joseph please update release notes and add runbook link. we'll reconvene in morning if any new signals.

pat: one more ask: add a note to the canary rollout docs about verifying streaming flags when upgrading SDK/runtime combos.

joseph: will add doc note under /docs/release/playbooks/canary-streaming.md and link in RN-5120.

deploybot: Deploybot: Pin will remain until 2026-03-22T03:00:00Z or until manually cleared. Use `/unpin-runtime us-west` to clear early.

alex: thanks all. good quick containment.
